title: Publish witnessed European compact OBJ animations
changes: Publish the authenticated compact OBJ projection in e101 with typed owner composition and usage counters while preserving guest indexing and fallback.
validation: Corrected isolated Windows build and focused Wine managed/native test passed: 90 prior files unchanged, all source bytes and mixed boundaries, transactional tamper rejection, and original prefix full-state and clock equivalence for eleven selectors.
limitations: First build failed on three missing budget-test arguments and was corrected. Older generation/count assertions were updated but not individually rerun. CLI, ordinary use, unwitnessed data, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
